verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Ollama running diverse model types—standard LLMs (Gemma4), MoE architectures (qwen3.5:35b-a3b), and multimodal models (confirmed working in comm-18)—via simple pull/run commands, supporting the 'hundreds of architectures' claim. However, no direct evidence of embedding-model support or architecture count is provided, and some community friction around model management/registry lock-in tempers full confidence.
